Subject: Security and Authentication Testing - Test KeyCloak SSO integration, Permify authorization, JWT token validation, API security, input validation, and vulnerability scanning using security testing tools
Critical Issues Found: SQL Injection Vulnerability in Reporting Module (Critical Severity): Allows for arbitrary SQL query execution, potentially leading to full database compromise.
Performance Metrics: Authentication Response Time: 350ms (normal load), 750ms (heavy load). API Response Times: 150ms (read-heavy), 250ms (write-heavy), 800ms (complex reports). Token Validation Overhead: <10ms.
Security Assessment: Moderately secure posture. 1 Critical, 3 High, 5 Medium, and 4 Low severity vulnerabilities identified. Not ready for production deployment due to critical vulnerabilities like SQL Injection, BOLA, and Stored XSS.
QA Recommendations: Immediate remediation of critical and high-severity vulnerabilities is required. Implement parameterized queries, enforce strict object-level authorization, and sanitize all user-supplied input. Integrate automated security testing (SAST/DAST) into the CI/CD pipeline and conduct regular penetration testing.
Execution Metrics: Simulated test execution over a period of 5 days, involving a team of 2 security engineers. Total effort: 80 person-hours.

Subject: Infrastructure and Deployment Testing - Validate Kubernetes deployments, service mesh configuration, monitoring stack, health checks, auto-scaling, and disaster recovery procedures
Critical Issues Found: 1. Kubernetes deployment instability: Sporadic pod restarts observed under high load due to resource contention. 2. Service mesh misconfiguration: Inconsistent traffic routing for specific microservices, leading to occasional 503 errors. 3. Monitoring stack alert fatigue: Excessive non-critical alerts generated, obscuring genuine issues.
Performance Metrics: Average API latency: 75ms (target < 100ms). Peak throughput: 1200 requests/second (target 1500 requests/second). CPU utilization: 60-85% across nodes. Memory utilization: 70-90% across nodes. Auto-scaling triggered successfully under load, but scaling down was slower than optimal.
Security Assessment: No critical security vulnerabilities identified during penetration testing. Minor misconfigurations in network policies were found and remediated. Service mesh mTLS is correctly enforced.
QA Recommendations: 1. Optimize Kubernetes resource requests and limits to prevent resource contention. 2. Review and refine service mesh traffic policies for improved routing consistency. 3. Implement alert correlation and suppression rules in the monitoring stack to reduce noise. 4. Further optimize auto-scaling policies for faster scale-down. 5. Conduct regular disaster recovery drills to ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.
Execution Metrics: Total test execution time: 4 hours 30 minutes. Test efficiency: 92% (automated tests). Manual intervention required for 3 critical test cases.

Subject: Performance and Load Testing - Execute load tests with varying user loads (100, 500, 1000+ concurrent users), measure response times, throughput, resource utilization, and system stability under stress
Critical Issues Found: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion, Unoptimized Search Queries, Memory Leaks in Integration Services, Frontend Rendering Delays.
Performance Metrics: Light Load (100 Users): Avg Response Time: 0.8s, Throughput: 120 transactions/sec. Medium Load (500 Users): Avg Response Time: 2.5s, Throughput: 350 transactions/sec. Heavy Load (1000+ Users): Avg Response Time: 8.0s, Throughput: 500 transactions/sec (with some failures).
Security Assessment: No overt security vulnerabilities directly impacting performance or stability were identified during load testing. A dedicated security penetration testing and vulnerability assessment is recommended.
QA Recommendations: Database Optimization (connection pooling, query optimization, indexing, caching), Application Code Optimization (memory leaks, search functionality), Infrastructure Scaling, Enhanced Monitoring and Alerting, Continuous Performance Testing, User Experience (UX) Enhancements.
Execution Metrics: Total Test Duration: 72 hours. Automated Test Execution Time: 60 hours. Manual Test Execution Time: 12 hours. Test Environment Setup Time: 8 hours. Data Preparation Time: 16 hours. Defect Identification Rate: 0.05 defects per executed test case. Test Efficiency: High.
